' GravenMain.vg — GRAVEN R2 physics fix (mass tune; global Const unchanged)
' Kenney refs when downloaded: 1-Bit Pack OR Abstract Platformer OR Pattern Pack (# tiles);
'   Space Shooter Redux playerShip1_blue.png (Sprite2D, rotate with podAngle)
' Modules: GravenPulse.vg (sonar/shader), GravenRooms.vg (maps/transitions),
'   GravenObjects.vg (crate, orbit, heat, skiff, end card)

Option Explicit

' Constants — tuning targets from BLUEPRINT.md
Const GAME_W As Single = 1280
Const GAME_H As Single = 704
Const TILE As Single = 32
Const COLS As Integer = 40
Const ROWS As Integer = 22

Const THRUST As Single = 420
Const VMAX As Single = 280
Const DRAG As Single = 0.92
Const DRAG_COAST As Single = 0.99
Const G_SCALE As Single = 240000
Const G_MIN_DIST As Single = 40
Const G_MAX As Single = 800
Const POD_R As Single = 12
Const CRATE_R As Single = 14
Const CRATE_VMAX As Single = 180
Const CRATE_DRAG As Single = 0.88

' Constants — heat suit stress (R7 corridor; drives shader heat_stress)
Const HEAT_MAX As Single = 100
Const HEAT_IDLE As Single = 1.5
Const HEAT_THRUST As Single = 8
Const HEAT_THRUST_R7 As Single = 12
Const HEAT_ZONE_MUL As Single = 1.8
Const HEAT_ZONE_TX0 As Integer = 10
Const HEAT_ZONE_TX1 As Integer = 30

' Constants — R8 skiff win trigger (circle overlap, not AABB square)
Const SKIFF_X As Single = 1100
Const SKIFF_Y As Single = 400
Const SKIFF_R As Single = 28

' Palette — void/stone/glow from BLUEPRINT; edge #2a3a4a on cave tile faces
Const VOID_R As Single = 0.0392157
Const VOID_G As Single = 0.054902
Const VOID_B As Single = 0.0784314
Const STONE_R As Single = 0.1019608
Const STONE_G As Single = 0.145098
Const STONE_B As Single = 0.1882353
Const EDGE_R As Single = 0.1647059
Const EDGE_G As Single = 0.227451
Const EDGE_B As Single = 0.2901961
Const GLOW_R As Single = 0.2392157
Const GLOW_G As Single = 0.8
Const GLOW_B As Single = 1.0

' State — orbit gate (Room 6); declared before includes for IsSolidTile access
Dim orbitAngle As Single
Dim orbitComplete As Boolean
Dim lastOrbitRad As Single
Dim orbitInBand As Boolean
Dim heatStress As Single

' State — heat + end card (R7/R8); declared before includes for module access
Dim podHeat As Single
Dim gameWon As Boolean

Include "GravenPulse.vg"
Include "GravenRooms.vg"
Include "GravenObjects.vg"

' State — pod kinematics
Dim podX As Single
Dim podY As Single
Dim podVX As Single
Dim podVY As Single
Dim podAngle As Single
Dim gravAX As Single
Dim gravAY As Single

' State — room + mass nodes (up to 4 per room)
Dim roomId As Integer

Dim massX(3) As Single
Dim massY(3) As Single
Dim massS(3) As Single
Dim tileChar(39, 21) As String

' State — draw flag + HUD

Dim showMassDebug As Boolean

' State — beacon checkpoint (R4 + R6 saves)

' State — Room 4 objects (crate, plate, terminal)
Dim crateActive As Boolean
Dim crateX As Single
Dim crateY As Single
Dim crateVX As Single
Dim crateVY As Single
Dim plateSatisfied As Boolean
Dim terminalOpen As Boolean
Dim terminalTimer As Single

' Handler: _Ready — init Room 1, load tiles/masses, spawn pod, cache post FX
Sub _Ready()
	beaconRoom = 0
	showMassDebug = False
	heatStress = 0
	podHeat = HEAT_MAX
	gameWon = False
	endFade = 0
	orbitComplete = False
	orbitAngle = 0
	roomLabel = GetNode("HUD/RoomLabel")
	Call InitPulseNodes()
	Call LoadRoom(1)
	QueueRedraw()
	Print "GRAVEN — W thrust, Q/E rotate, Space Pulse, R7 heat, R8 skiff"
End Sub

' Handler: GravityAccel — inverse-square pull toward room mass nodes (pod)
Sub GravityAccel(px As Single, py As Single)
	Call GravityAccelAt(px, py, gravAX, gravAY)
End Sub

' Handler: GravityAccelAt — shared gravity for pod and crate
Sub GravityAccelAt(px As Single, py As Single, ByRef ax As Single, ByRef ay As Single)
	Dim i As Integer
	Dim dx As Single
	Dim dy As Single
	Dim distSq As Single
	Dim dist As Single
	Dim pull As Single
	Dim mx As Single
	Dim my As Single
	Dim ms As Single
	ax = 0
	ay = 0
	For i = 0 To massCount - 1
		mx = massX(i)
		my = massY(i)
		ms = massS(i)
		dx = mx - px
		dy = my - py
		distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy
		If distSq < G_MIN_DIST * G_MIN_DIST Then distSq = G_MIN_DIST * G_MIN_DIST
		dist = Sqr(distSq)
		pull = G_SCALE * ms / distSq
		If pull > G_MAX Then pull = G_MAX
		ax = ax + (dx / dist) * pull
		ay = ay + (dy / dist) * pull
	Next i
End Sub

' Handler: CircleRectOverlap — circle vs axis-aligned rect; dist² not Sqr()
Function CircleRectOverlap(cx As Single, cy As Single, cr As Single, rx As Single, ry As Single, rw As Single, rh As Single) As Boolean
	Dim nx As Single
	Dim ny As Single
	Dim dx As Single
	Dim dy As Single
	nx = cx
	If nx < rx Then nx = rx
	If nx > rx + rw Then nx = rx + rw
	ny = cy
	If ny < ry Then ny = ry
	If ny > ry + rh Then ny = ry + rh
	dx = cx - nx
	dy = cy - ny
	CircleRectOverlap = (dx * dx + dy * dy) <= (cr * cr)
End Function

' Handler: PodHitsSolid — sample tile grid under pod circle
Function PodHitsSolid() As Boolean
	PodHitsSolid = CircleHitsSolid(podX, podY, POD_R)
End Function

' Handler: ResolvePodCollision — nudge pod out of solids with velocity bounce
Sub ResolvePodCollision()
	Dim tries As Integer
	Dim ox As Single
	Dim oy As Single
	Dim px As Single
	Dim py As Single
	Dim pvx As Single
	Dim pvy As Single
	px = podX
	py = podY
	pvx = podVX
	pvy = podVY
	tries = 0
	Do While CircleHitsSolid(px, py, POD_R) And tries < 8
		ox = px
		oy = py
		px = px - pvx * 0.016
		py = py - pvy * 0.016
		pvx = pvx * -0.25
		pvy = pvy * -0.25
		If Abs(px - ox) < 0.01 And Abs(py - oy) < 0.01 Then
			py = py - 2
		End If
		tries = tries + 1
		needRedraw = True
	Loop
	podX = px
	podY = py
	podVX = pvx
	podVY = pvy
End Sub

' Handler: DrawCaveTiles — 32px stone cells with bevel so walls read as tiles
Sub DrawCaveTiles()
	Dim tx As Integer
	Dim ty As Integer
	Dim px As Single
	Dim py As Single
	Dim stoneCol As Variant
	Dim hiCol As Variant
	Dim loCol As Variant
	stoneCol = Color(0.20, 0.28, 0.36, 1.0)
	hiCol = Color(0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.55)
	loCol = Color(0.08, 0.12, 0.16, 0.75)
	For ty = 0 To ROWS - 1
		For tx = 0 To COLS - 1
			If IsSolidTile(tx, ty) Then
				px = tx * TILE
				py = ty * TILE
				If roomDark Then
					DrawRect px, py, TILE, TILE, Lit(STONE_R, STONE_G, STONE_B, 1.0)
				Else
					DrawRect px, py, TILE, TILE, stoneCol
					DrawLine px + 1, py + 1, px + TILE - 2, py + 1, hiCol
					DrawLine px + 1, py + 1, px + 1, py + TILE - 2, hiCol
					DrawLine px + TILE - 2, py + 1, px + TILE - 2, py + TILE - 2, loCol
					DrawLine px + 1, py + TILE - 2, px + TILE - 2, py + TILE - 2, loCol
				End If
			End If
		Next tx
	Next ty
End Sub

' Handler: DrawPodCapsule — greybox pod capsule along facing (#3dccff glow)
Sub DrawPodCapsule()
	Dim rad As Single
	Dim fx As Single
	Dim fy As Single
	Dim bx As Single
	Dim by As Single
	Dim hullR As Single
	Dim bodyLen As Single
	rad = Deg2Rad(podAngle)
	fx = Cos(rad)
	fy = Sin(rad)
	bodyLen = 14
	bx = podX - fx * bodyLen * 0.5
	by = podY - fy * bodyLen * 0.5
	DrawRect bx - 4, by - 6, bodyLen + 8, 12, Lit(STONE_R, STONE_G, STONE_B, 1.0)
	DrawRect bx, by - 4, bodyLen, 8, Lit(GLOW_R, GLOW_G, GLOW_B, 0.85)
	hullR = POD_R
	DrawCircle podX + fx * 10, podY + fy * 10, hullR - 2, Lit(STONE_R, STONE_G, STONE_B, 1.0)
	DrawCircle podX + fx * 10, podY + fy * 10, hullR - 6, Lit(GLOW_R, GLOW_G, GLOW_B, 1.0)
	DrawCircle podX - fx * 8, podY - fy * 8, hullR - 4, Lit(STONE_R, STONE_G, STONE_B, 1.0)
	DrawLine podX - fx * 14, podY - fy * 14, podX - fx * 20, podY - fy * 20, Lit(GLOW_R, GLOW_G, GLOW_B, 0.5)
End Sub

' Handler: DrawMassDebug — G key crosshairs on mass nodes (Prompt 2 debug)
Sub DrawMassDebug()
	Dim i As Integer
	Dim mx As Single
	Dim my As Single
	If Not showMassDebug Then Exit Sub
	For i = 0 To massCount - 1
		mx = massX(i)
		my = massY(i)
		DrawLine mx - 12, my, mx + 12, my, Lit(1.0, 0.2, 0.2, 0.9)
		DrawLine mx, my - 12, mx, my + 12, Lit(1.0, 0.2, 0.2, 0.9)
	Next i
End Sub

' Handler: ProcessEndCardFrame — fade overlay only; redraw when fade advances
Sub ProcessEndCardFrame(delta As Single)
	Dim fadeBefore As Single
	fadeBefore = endFade
	Call UpdateEndSequence(delta)
	Call UpdatePostShader()
	Call TryReplay()
	If endFade <> fadeBefore Then needRedraw = True
	If needRedraw Then
		QueueRedraw()
		needRedraw = False
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: ProcessInputPhase — rotate taps + debug toggle
Sub ProcessInputPhase()
	showMassDebug = Input.IsKeyPressed(KEY_G)
	If showMassDebug Then needRedraw = True
	If Input.IsActionJustPressed("rotate_ccw") Then
		podAngle = podAngle - 90
		needRedraw = True
	End If
	If Input.IsActionJustPressed("rotate_cw") Then
		podAngle = podAngle + 90
		needRedraw = True
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: ProcessGravityPhase — integrate thrust + inverse-square pull
Sub ProcessGravityPhase(delta As Single, ByRef thrusting As Boolean, ByRef oldX As Single, ByRef oldY As Single)
	Dim ax As Single
	Dim ay As Single
	Dim spd As Single
	Dim rad As Single
	thrusting = Input.IsActionPressed("thrust")
	Call GravityAccel(podX, podY)
	ax = gravAX
	ay = gravAY
	If thrusting Then
		rad = Deg2Rad(podAngle)
		ax = ax + Cos(rad) * THRUST
		ay = ay + Sin(rad) * THRUST
	End If
	oldX = podX
	oldY = podY
	podVX = podVX + ax * delta
	podVY = podVY + ay * delta
	spd = Sqr(podVX * podVX + podVY * podVY)
	If spd > VMAX Then
		podVX = podVX * (VMAX / spd)
		podVY = podVY * (VMAX / spd)
	End If
	If thrusting Then
		podVX = podVX * DRAG
		podVY = podVY * DRAG
	Else
		podVX = podVX * DRAG_COAST
		podVY = podVY * DRAG_COAST
	End If
	podX = podX + podVX * delta
	podY = podY + podVY * delta
End Sub

' Handler: ProcessCollidePhase — collisions, objects, room transitions
Sub ProcessCollidePhase(delta As Single, thrusting As Boolean)
	Call ResolvePodCollision()
	Call UpdateCrate(delta)
	Call TryTerminalInteract()
	Call UpdateTerminal(delta)
	Call CheckSpikeDeath()
	Call UpdateHeat(delta, thrusting)
	Call UpdateOrbit(delta)
	Call TryRoomTransition()
	Call CheckSkiffWin()
	Call CheckOutOfBoundsDeath()
End Sub

' Handler: FlushRedrawIfNeeded — queue _Draw only when visible state changed
Sub FlushRedrawIfNeeded(oldX As Single, oldY As Single, thrusting As Boolean)
	If Abs(podX - oldX) > 0.05 Or Abs(podY - oldY) > 0.05 Or thrusting Then
		needRedraw = True
	End If
	If needRedraw Then
		QueueRedraw()
		needRedraw = False
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: _Process — phased loop: Input, Gravity, Collide, Draw flag
Sub _Process(delta As Single)
	Dim oldX As Single
	Dim oldY As Single
	Dim thrusting As Boolean

	If gameWon Then
		Call ProcessEndCardFrame(delta)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	' Input — rotate, debug crosses
	Call ProcessInputPhase()

	' Pulse — sonar tick (R5 dark pool)
	Call TryStartPulse()
	Call UpdatePulse(delta)

	' Gravity — thrust + inverse-square integration
	Call ProcessGravityPhase(delta, thrusting, oldX, oldY)

	' Collide — tile bounce, crate, heat, orbit, exits
	Call ProcessCollidePhase(delta, thrusting)

	' Shader — post FX uniforms (not canvas; no QueueRedraw by itself)
	Call UpdatePostShader()

	' Draw flag — skip unconditional per-room redraw; modules set needRedraw
	Call FlushRedrawIfNeeded(oldX, oldY, thrusting)
End Sub

' Handler: _Draw — void bg, cave tiles, entities, pod, HUD, heat bar, end card
Sub _Draw()
	Dim nlen As Single
	Dim i As Integer
	Dim mx As Single
	Dim my As Single

	DrawRect 0, 0, GAME_W, GAME_H, Lit(VOID_R, VOID_G, VOID_B, 1.0)
	Call DrawCaveTiles()
	Call DrawExitMarkers()
	Call DrawGateTiles()
	Call DrawHeatZoneTint()

	For i = 0 To massCount - 1
		mx = massX(i)
		my = massY(i)
		DrawCircle mx, my, 6, Lit(GLOW_R, GLOW_G, GLOW_B, 0.35)
	Next i
	Call DrawMassDebug()

	Call DrawRoomObjects()
	If Not gameWon Then
		Call DrawPodCapsule()
	End If
	Call DrawPulseRing()

	nlen = Sqr(gravAX * gravAX + gravAY * gravAY)
	If nlen > 0.01 And Not gameWon Then
		DrawLine podX, podY, podX + gravAX / nlen * 32, podY + gravAY / nlen * 32, Lit(1.0, 0.69, 0.125, 0.9)
	End If

	DrawString statusText, 16, GAME_H - 24, Lit(0.91, 0.96, 1, 0.75), 16
	Call DrawHeatBar()
	Call DrawPulseHud()
	Call DrawOrbitHud()
	Call DrawEndCard()
End Sub

' GravenRooms.vg — room tile maps, mass tables, spawn/exit transitions (R2 mass physics fix)

' Handler: LoadRoomTiles — parse ASCII Data rows into tileChar grid for roomId
Sub LoadRoomTiles()
	Dim ty As Integer
	Dim row As String
	For ty = 0 To ROWS - 1
		Call ClearRoomRow(ty)
	Next ty
	If roomId = 1 Then
		Restore R1Map
	ElseIf roomId = 2 Then
		Restore R2Map
	ElseIf roomId = 3 Then
		Restore R3Map
	ElseIf roomId = 4 Then
		Restore R4Map
	ElseIf roomId = 5 Then
		Restore R5Map
	ElseIf roomId = 6 Then
		Restore R6Map
	ElseIf roomId = 7 Then
		Restore R7Map
	ElseIf roomId = 8 Then
		Restore R8Map
	Else
		Exit Sub
	End If
	For ty = 0 To ROWS - 1
		Read row
		Call ParseRoomRow(row, ty)
	Next ty
End Sub

' Handler: ClearRoomRow — fill one row with air markers
Sub ClearRoomRow(ty As Integer)
	Dim tx As Integer
	For tx = 0 To COLS - 1
		tileChar(tx, ty) = "."
	Next tx
End Sub

' Handler: ParseRoomRow — copy row string into tileChar (40 cols)
Sub ParseRoomRow(row As String, ty As Integer)
	Dim tx As Integer
	Dim ch As String
	For tx = 0 To COLS - 1
		If tx < Len(row) Then
			ch = Mid(row, tx + 1, 1)
		Else
			ch = "."
		End If
		tileChar(tx, ty) = ch
	Next tx
End Sub

' Handler: IsSolidTile — # and closed G gate block pod/crate; OOB solid
Function IsSolidTile(tx As Integer, ty As Integer) As Boolean
	Dim ch As String
	If tx < 0 Or tx >= COLS Or ty < 0 Or ty >= ROWS Then
		IsSolidTile = True
		Exit Function
	End If
	ch = tileChar(tx, ty)
	If ch = "#" Then
		IsSolidTile = True
		Exit Function
	End If
	' Gate tiles stay solid until orbitComplete (R6 east exit)
	If ch = "G" And Not orbitComplete Then
		IsSolidTile = True
		Exit Function
	End If
	IsSolidTile = False
End Function

' Handler: IsSpikeTile — S cells kill pod on touch (R5 hazard row)
Function IsSpikeTile(tx As Integer, ty As Integer) As Boolean
	If tx < 0 Or tx >= COLS Or ty < 0 Or ty >= ROWS Then
		IsSpikeTile = False
		Exit Function
	End If
	IsSpikeTile = (tileChar(tx, ty) = "S")
End Function

' Handler: IsGateTile — G marker for draw overlay (not # solid)
Function IsGateTile(tx As Integer, ty As Integer) As Boolean
	If tx < 0 Or tx >= COLS Or ty < 0 Or ty >= ROWS Then
		IsGateTile = False
		Exit Function
	End If
	IsGateTile = (tileChar(tx, ty) = "G")
End Function

		massY(0) = 780

		massY(1) = 320

		massCount = 1
		massX(0) = 640
		massY(0) = -60
		massS(0) = 2.0
	ElseIf roomId = 4 Then
		massCount = 1
		massX(0) = 640
		massY(0) = 780
		massS(0) = 1.0
	ElseIf roomId = 5 Then
		massCount = 2
		massX(0) = 200
		massY(0) = 400
		massS(0) = 1.4
		massX(1) = 1080
		massY(1) = 400
		massS(1) = 1.4
	ElseIf roomId = 6 Then
		massCount = 1
		massX(0) = 640
		massY(0) = 352
		massS(0) = 2.5
	ElseIf roomId = 7 Then
		massCount = 1
		massX(0) = 640
		massY(0) = 780
		massS(0) = 1.2
	ElseIf roomId = 8 Then
		massCount = 0
	End If
End Sub

	podAngle = 0

		podX = 272
		podY = 560
	ElseIf roomId = 2 Then
		podX = 48
		podY = 560
	ElseIf roomId = 3 Then
		podX = 16
		podY = 144
	ElseIf roomId = 4 Then
		podX = 144
		podY = 496
	ElseIf roomId = 5 Then
		podX = 144
		podY = 528
	ElseIf roomId = 6 Then
		podX = 80
		podY = 560
	ElseIf roomId = 7 Then
		podX = 48
		podY = 368
	ElseIf roomId = 8 Then
		podX = 48
		podY = 496
	Else
		podX = 64
		podY = 560
	End If
End Sub

		GetRoomCaption = "GRAVEN — Room 1 Airlock"
	ElseIf roomId = 2 Then
		GetRoomCaption = "GRAVEN — Room 2 Bend"
	ElseIf roomId = 3 Then
		GetRoomCaption = "GRAVEN — Room 3 Shelf"
	ElseIf roomId = 4 Then
		GetRoomCaption = "GRAVEN — Room 4 Crate"
	ElseIf roomId = 5 Then
		GetRoomCaption = "GRAVEN — Room 5 Dark pool"
	ElseIf roomId = 6 Then
		GetRoomCaption = "GRAVEN — Room 6 Orbit"
	ElseIf roomId = 7 Then
		GetRoomCaption = "GRAVEN — Room 7 Heat run"
	ElseIf roomId = 8 Then

	Else

' Handler: GetRoomHint — status bar blurb
Function GetRoomHint() As String
	If roomId = 1 Then
		GetRoomHint = "Fly east along the floor — glowing exit leads to Room 2"
	ElseIf roomId = 2 Then
		GetRoomHint = "Curve into the ceiling channel — east exit when ready"
	ElseIf roomId = 3 Then
		GetRoomHint = "Mass pulls up — walk the ceiling shelf to the east exit"
	ElseIf roomId = 4 Then
		GetRoomHint = "Push crate onto floor plate (F at terminal for log)"
	ElseIf roomId = 5 Then
		GetRoomHint = "Space — Pulse sonar; cross spikes to east exit"
	ElseIf roomId = 6 Then
		If orbitComplete Then
			GetRoomHint = "Orbit gate open — exit east"
		Else
			GetRoomHint = "Orbit the mass (80–200 px) — 540° opens east gate"
		End If
	ElseIf roomId = 7 Then
		GetRoomHint = "Manage heat — thrust drains suit; hot zone ×1.8 drain"
	ElseIf roomId = 8 Then
		GetRoomHint = "Reach the skiff — escape the masswell"
	Else
		GetRoomHint = ""
	End If
End Function

' Handler: LoadRoom — swap tiles, masses, entities, beacon saves
Sub LoadRoom(newId As Integer)
	roomId = newId
	Call LoadRoomTiles()
	Call LoadRoomMasses()
	Call InitRoomObjects()
	Call InitPulseForRoom()
	Call InitOrbitForRoom()
	Call InitHeatForRoom()
	Call ResetPodSpawn()
	statusText = GetRoomHint()
	If roomId = 4 Then
		Call SetBeaconCheckpointAt(4, 144, 496)
	End If
	If roomId = 6 Then
		Call SetBeaconCheckpointAt(6, 3 * TILE + 16, 2 * TILE + 16)
	End If
	If roomLabel <> Null Then
		roomLabel.Caption = GetRoomCaption()
	End If
	needRedraw = True
End Sub

' Handler: PodInZone — pod circle overlaps exit trigger (not center-point only)
Function PodInZone(zx As Single, zy As Single, zw As Single, zh As Single) As Boolean
	PodInZone = CircleRectOverlap(podX, podY, POD_R + 4, zx, zy, zw, zh)
End Function

' Handler: TryRoomTransition — circle vs generous exit zones (touch to transition)
Sub TryRoomTransition()
	If roomId = 1 Then
		' R1 east — E tile row 17; trigger when pod reaches glow, not after crossing
		If PodInZone(36 * TILE, 15 * TILE, 4 * TILE, 5 * TILE) Then
			Call LoadRoom(2)
		End If
	ElseIf roomId = 2 Then
		If PodInZone(29 * TILE, 8 * TILE, 4 * TILE, 5 * TILE) Then
			Call LoadRoom(3)
		End If
	ElseIf roomId = 3 Then
		If PodInZone(37 * TILE, 0, 3 * TILE, 4 * TILE) Then
			Call LoadRoom(4)
		End If
	ElseIf roomId = 4 Then
		If plateSatisfied Then
			If PodInZone(18 * TILE, 20 * TILE, 4 * TILE, 3 * TILE) Then
				Call LoadRoom(5)
			End If
		End If
	ElseIf roomId = 5 Then
		If PodInZone(37 * TILE, 14 * TILE, 3 * TILE, 4 * TILE) Then
			Call LoadRoom(6)
		End If
	ElseIf roomId = 6 Then
		If orbitComplete Then
			If PodInZone(37 * TILE, 16 * TILE, 3 * TILE, 4 * TILE) Then
				Call LoadRoom(7)
			End If
		End If
	ElseIf roomId = 7 Then
		If PodInZone(37 * TILE, 10 * TILE, 3 * TILE, 9 * TILE) Then
			Call LoadRoom(8)
		End If
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: IsExitTile — E marker from ASCII maps (transition target hint)
Function IsExitTile(tx As Integer, ty As Integer) As Boolean
	If tx < 0 Or tx >= COLS Or ty < 0 Or ty >= ROWS Then
		IsExitTile = False
		Exit Function
	End If
	IsExitTile = (tileChar(tx, ty) = "E")
End Function

		Next tx

' GravenObjects.vg — crate, plate, beacon, spikes, orbit gate, heat, skiff, end card

' Constants — hazard palette #ffb020 from BLUEPRINT
Const HAZARD_R As Single = 1.0
Const HAZARD_G As Single = 0.6901961
Const HAZARD_B As Single = 0.0784314

' Constants — orbit band radii (BLUEPRINT R6)
Const ORBIT_R_MIN As Single = 80
Const ORBIT_R_MAX As Single = 200
Const ORBIT_DEG_NEED As Single = 540

' Handler: InitRoomObjects — reset per-room interactables
Sub InitRoomObjects()
	crateActive = False
	plateSatisfied = False
	terminalOpen = False
	terminalTimer = 0
	If roomId = 4 Then
		crateActive = True
		crateX = 400
		crateY = 528
		crateVX = 0
		crateVY = 0
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: InitHeatForRoom — full heat tank on R7 entry; stress off elsewhere
Sub InitHeatForRoom()
	If roomId = 7 Then
		podHeat = HEAT_MAX
		heatStress = 0
	Else
		heatStress = 0
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: InitOrbitForRoom — reset angle tracker on R6 entry (keep orbitComplete)
Sub InitOrbitForRoom()
	orbitInBand = False
	lastOrbitRad = 0
	If roomId = 6 Then
		If Not orbitComplete Then
			orbitAngle = 0
		End If
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: PodInHeatZone — R7 corridor tx 10–30 drains ×1.8
Function PodInHeatZone() As Boolean
	Dim tx As Integer
	tx = Int(podX / TILE)
	PodInHeatZone = (tx >= HEAT_ZONE_TX0 And tx <= HEAT_ZONE_TX1)
End Function

' Handler: UpdateHeat — idle + thrust drain; empty heat = beacon respawn (R7 only)
Sub UpdateHeat(delta As Single, thrusting As Boolean)
	Dim drain As Single
	Dim mul As Single
	Dim heatBefore As Single
	If roomId <> 7 Then
		heatStress = 0
		Exit Sub
	End If
	heatBefore = podHeat
	drain = HEAT_IDLE
	If thrusting Then
		drain = drain + HEAT_THRUST_R7
	End If
	mul = 1.0
	If PodInHeatZone() Then mul = HEAT_ZONE_MUL
	podHeat = podHeat - drain * mul * delta
	If podHeat < 0 Then podHeat = 0
	heatStress = 1.0 - (podHeat / HEAT_MAX)
	If Abs(podHeat - heatBefore) > 0.08 Then needRedraw = True
	If podHeat <= 0 Then
		Call RespawnPod()
		podHeat = HEAT_MAX
		heatStress = 0
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: UpdateOrbit — accumulate angle around M0 while dist in [80,200]
Sub UpdateOrbit(delta As Single)
	Dim mx As Single
	Dim my As Single
	Dim dx As Single
	Dim dy As Single
	Dim dist As Single
	Dim ang As Single
	Dim dAng As Single
	Dim degAdd As Single
	If roomId <> 6 Then Exit Sub
	If orbitComplete Then Exit Sub
	mx = massX(0)
	my = massY(0)
	dx = podX - mx
	dy = podY - my
	dist = Sqr(dx * dx + dy * dy)
	If dist >= ORBIT_R_MIN And dist <= ORBIT_R_MAX Then
		ang = Atan2(dy, dx)
		If orbitInBand Then
			dAng = ang - lastOrbitRad
			While dAng > 3.14159265
				dAng = dAng - 6.2831853
			Wend
			While dAng < -3.14159265
				dAng = dAng + 6.2831853
			Wend
			degAdd = Abs(dAng) * 57.2958
			If degAdd > 0.02 Then
				orbitAngle = orbitAngle + degAdd
				needRedraw = True
			End If
		End If
		lastOrbitRad = ang
		orbitInBand = True
	Else
		orbitInBand = False
	End If
	If orbitAngle >= ORBIT_DEG_NEED And Not orbitComplete Then
		orbitComplete = True
		statusText = GetRoomHint()
		needRedraw = True
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: CircleHitsSolid — generic circle vs # and closed G tiles
Function CircleHitsSolid(cx As Single, cy As Single, cr As Single) As Boolean
	Dim tx0 As Integer
	Dim ty0 As Integer
	Dim tx1 As Integer
	Dim ty1 As Integer
	Dim tx As Integer
	Dim ty As Integer
	tx0 = Int((cx - cr) / TILE)
	If tx0 < 0 Then tx0 = 0
	ty0 = Int((cy - cr) / TILE)
	If ty0 < 0 Then ty0 = 0
	tx1 = Int((cx + cr) / TILE)
	If tx1 >= COLS Then tx1 = COLS - 1
	ty1 = Int((cy + cr) / TILE)
	If ty1 >= ROWS Then ty1 = ROWS - 1
	For ty = ty0 To ty1
		For tx = tx0 To tx1
			If IsSolidTile(tx, ty) Then
				If CircleRectOverlap(cx, cy, cr, tx * TILE, ty * TILE, TILE, TILE) Then
					CircleHitsSolid = True
					Exit Function
				End If
			End If
		Next tx
	Next ty
	CircleHitsSolid = False
End Function

' Handler: CircleHitsSpike — circle vs S hazard tiles (always deadly)
Function CircleHitsSpike(cx As Single, cy As Single, cr As Single) As Boolean
	Dim tx0 As Integer
	Dim ty0 As Integer
	Dim tx1 As Integer
	Dim ty1 As Integer
	Dim tx As Integer
	Dim ty As Integer
	tx0 = Int((cx - cr) / TILE)
	If tx0 < 0 Then tx0 = 0
	ty0 = Int((cy - cr) / TILE)
	If ty0 < 0 Then ty0 = 0
	tx1 = Int((cx + cr) / TILE)
	If tx1 >= COLS Then tx1 = COLS - 1
	ty1 = Int((cy + cr) / TILE)
	If ty1 >= ROWS Then ty1 = ROWS - 1
	For ty = ty0 To ty1
		For tx = tx0 To tx1
			If IsSpikeTile(tx, ty) Then
				If CircleRectOverlap(cx, cy, cr, tx * TILE, ty * TILE, TILE, TILE) Then
					CircleHitsSpike = True
					Exit Function
				End If
			End If
		Next tx
	Next ty
	CircleHitsSpike = False
End Function

' Handler: ResolveCircleCollision — nudge circle out of solids (scalars for ByRef)
Sub ResolveCircleCollision(ByRef cx As Single, ByRef cy As Single, ByRef cvx As Single, ByRef cvy As Single)
	Dim tries As Integer
	Dim ox As Single
	Dim oy As Single
	tries = 0
	Do While CircleHitsSolid(cx, cy, CRATE_R) And tries < 8
		ox = cx
		oy = cy
		cx = cx - cvx * 0.016
		cy = cy - cvy * 0.016
		cvx = cvx * -0.25
		cvy = cvy * -0.25
		If Abs(cx - ox) < 0.01 And Abs(cy - oy) < 0.01 Then
			cy = cy - 2
		End If
		tries = tries + 1
		needRedraw = True
	Loop
End Sub

' Handler: PushCrateFromPod — circle overlap transfers momentum (heavy crate feel)
Sub PushCrateFromPod()
	Dim dx As Single
	Dim dy As Single
	Dim distSq As Single
	Dim minD As Single
	If Not crateActive Then Exit Sub
	dx = crateX - podX
	dy = crateY - podY
	distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy
	minD = POD_R + CRATE_R
	If distSq < minD * minD And distSq > 0.01 Then
		crateVX = crateVX + podVX * 0.35
		crateVY = crateVY + podVY * 0.35
		needRedraw = True
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: UpdateCrate — gravity, drag, collide when Room 4 active
Sub UpdateCrate(delta As Single)
	Dim ax As Single
	Dim ay As Single
	Dim spd As Single
	Dim cx As Single
	Dim cy As Single
	Dim cvx As Single
	Dim cvy As Single
	If Not crateActive Then Exit Sub
	cx = crateX
	cy = crateY
	cvx = crateVX
	cvy = crateVY
	Call GravityAccelAt(cx, cy, ax, ay)
	cvx = cvx + ax * delta
	cvy = cvy + ay * delta
	spd = Sqr(cvx * cvx + cvy * cvy)
	If spd > CRATE_VMAX Then
		cvx = cvx * (CRATE_VMAX / spd)
		cvy = cvy * (CRATE_VMAX / spd)
	End If
	cvx = cvx * CRATE_DRAG
	cvy = cvy * CRATE_DRAG
	cx = cx + cvx * delta
	cy = cy + cvy * delta
	Call PushCrateFromPod()
	Call ResolveCircleCollision(cx, cy, cvx, cvy)
	crateX = cx
	crateY = cy
	crateVX = cvx
	crateVY = cvy
	Call UpdatePlateState()
End Sub

' Handler: UpdatePlateState — crate center within ±16 px of plate tile (28,18)
Sub UpdatePlateState()
	Dim px As Single
	Dim py As Single
	Dim dx As Single
	Dim dy As Single
	If Not crateActive Then Exit Sub
	px = 28 * TILE + 16
	py = 18 * TILE + 16
	dx = crateX - px
	dy = crateY - py
	If dx * dx + dy * dy <= 30 * 30 Then
		If Not plateSatisfied Then
			plateSatisfied = True
			statusText = "Floor plate open — south exit to Room 5"
			needRedraw = True
		End If
	Else
		If plateSatisfied Then
			plateSatisfied = False
			statusText = GetRoomHint()
			needRedraw = True
		End If
	End If
End Sub

			End If
		Next tx
	Next ty

' GravenPulse.vg — sonar Pulse, ambient dark room, graven_post shader uniform export

' Constants — BLUEPRINT PULSE_TIME / PULSE_CD
Const PULSE_TIME As Single = 2.8
Const PULSE_CD As Single = 4.0
Const AMBIENT_DARK As Single = 0.05
Const AMBIENT_NORMAL As Single = 0.5

' State — pulse timing + Room 5 dark flag + post material cache
Dim pulseTimer As Single
Dim pulseCooldown As Single
Dim roomDark As Boolean
Dim postRect As Variant
Dim postMaterial As Variant
Dim pulseHudSec As Integer

' Handler: InitPulseNodes — cache PostFX ColorRect material for shader uniforms
Sub InitPulseNodes()
	postRect = GetNode("PostFX/PulseRect")
	postMaterial = Null
	pulseHudSec = -1
	If postRect <> Null Then
		postMaterial = postRect.material
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: InitPulseForRoom — reset dark flag and pulse state on room swap
Sub InitPulseForRoom()
	roomDark = (roomId = 5)
	pulseHudSec = -1
	If roomId <> 5 Then
		pulseTimer = 0
		pulseCooldown = 0
	End If
	Call UpdatePostShader()
End Sub

' Handler: TryStartPulse — Space action; 4s cooldown, 2.8s reveal
Sub TryStartPulse()
	If pulseTimer > 0 Then Exit Sub
	If pulseCooldown > 0 Then Exit Sub
	If Not Input.IsActionJustPressed("pulse") Then Exit Sub
	pulseTimer = PULSE_TIME
	pulseCooldown = PULSE_CD
	pulseHudSec = -1
	needRedraw = True
End Sub

' Handler: UpdatePulse — tick active pulse and cooldown; redraw only on visible change
Sub UpdatePulse(delta As Single)
	Dim wasActive As Boolean
	Dim cdSec As Integer
	wasActive = (pulseTimer > 0)
	If pulseTimer > 0 Then
		pulseTimer = pulseTimer - delta
		If pulseTimer < 0 Then pulseTimer = 0
		needRedraw = True
	End If
	If pulseCooldown > 0 Then
		pulseCooldown = pulseCooldown - delta
		If pulseCooldown < 0 Then pulseCooldown = 0
		If roomDark Then
			cdSec = Int(pulseCooldown)
			If cdSec <> pulseHudSec Then
				pulseHudSec = cdSec
				needRedraw = True
			End If
		End If
	End If
	If wasActive And pulseTimer <= 0 Then needRedraw = True
End Sub

' Handler: IsPulseActive — true while sonar reveal window is open
Function IsPulseActive() As Boolean
	IsPulseActive = (pulseTimer > 0)
End Function

' Handler: GetPulsePhase — 0 at pulse start → 1 at end (shader + ring expansion)
Function GetPulsePhase() As Single
	If pulseTimer <= 0 Then
		GetPulsePhase = 0
		Exit Function
	End If
	GetPulsePhase = 1.0 - (pulseTimer / PULSE_TIME)
End Function

' Handler: GetAmbientMul — R5 dark 0.05 until Pulse; full 1.0 while active
Function GetAmbientMul() As Single
	If roomDark Then
		If pulseTimer > 0 Then
			GetAmbientMul = 1.0
		Else
			GetAmbientMul = AMBIENT_DARK
		End If
	Else
		GetAmbientMul = AMBIENT_NORMAL
	End If
End Function

' Handler: Lit — R5 dark pool dims canvas; other rooms draw at full palette
Function Lit(r As Single, g As Single, b As Single, a As Single) As Variant
	Dim amb As Single
	If roomDark Then
		amb = GetAmbientMul()
	Else
		amb = 1.0
	End If
	Lit = Color(r * amb, g * amb, b * amb, a)
End Function

' Handler: UpdatePostShader — all graven_post uniforms from nearest mass + accel
Sub UpdatePostShader()
	Dim i As Integer
	Dim bestI As Integer
	Dim bestD As Single
	Dim d As Single
	Dim dx As Single
	Dim dy As Single
	Dim gx As Single
	Dim gy As Single
	Dim glen As Single
	Dim mx As Single
	Dim my As Single
	If postMaterial = Null Then Exit Sub
	bestI = 0
	bestD = 999999999
	For i = 0 To massCount - 1
		mx = massX(i)
		my = massY(i)
		dx = podX - mx
		dy = podY - my
		d = dx * dx + dy * dy
		If d < bestD Then
			bestD = d
			bestI = i
		End If
	Next i
	If massCount > 0 Then
		mx = massX(bestI)
		my = massY(bestI)
		Shader.Param postMaterial, "mass_uv", Vector2(mx / GAME_W, my / GAME_H)
	Else
		Shader.Param postMaterial, "mass_uv", Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
	End If
	glen = Sqr(gravAX * gravAX + gravAY * gravAY)
	If glen > 0.01 Then
		gx = gravAX / glen
		gy = gravAY / glen
		If glen > G_MAX Then glen = G_MAX
		gx = gx * (glen / G_MAX)
		gy = gy * (glen / G_MAX)
	Else
		gx = 0
		gy = 1
	End If
	Shader.Param postMaterial, "gravity_vec", Vector2(gx, gy)
	Shader.Param postMaterial, "pulse_phase", GetPulsePhase()
	Shader.Param postMaterial, "heat_stress", heatStress
	Shader.Param postMaterial, "ambient", GetAmbientMul()
End Sub

' Handler: DrawPulseRing — expanding sonar outline; boosted contrast in R5 dark
Sub DrawPulseRing()
	Dim phase As Single
	Dim ringR As Single
	Dim alpha As Single
	Dim lineW As Single
	If Not IsPulseActive() Then Exit Sub
	phase = GetPulsePhase()
	ringR = 48 + phase * 380
	alpha = 0.85 * (1.0 - phase * 0.65)
	lineW = 2
	If roomDark Then
		alpha = alpha * 1.35
		If alpha > 1.0 Then alpha = 1.0
		lineW = 3
	End If
	DrawArc podX, podY, ringR, 0, 6.28318, 64, Lit(GLOW_R, GLOW_G, GLOW_B, alpha), lineW
	If phase > 0.15 Then
		DrawArc podX, podY, ringR * 0.55, 0, 6.28318, 48, Lit(GLOW_R, GLOW_G, GLOW_B, alpha * 0.55), lineW
	End If
	If roomDark Then
		DrawCircle podX, podY, 10, Lit(GLOW_R, GLOW_G, GLOW_B, 0.35)
	End If
End Sub

' Handler: DrawPulseHud — cooldown hint in Room 5
Sub DrawPulseHud()
	Dim cdText As String
	If Not roomDark Then Exit Sub
	If IsPulseActive() Then
		DrawString "PULSE ACTIVE", 16, GAME_H - 48, Lit(GLOW_R, GLOW_G, GLOW_B, 1.0), 15
	ElseIf pulseCooldown > 0 Then
		cdText = "Pulse recharge " & Str(Int(pulseCooldown * 10) / 10) & "s"
		DrawString cdText, 16, GAME_H - 48, Lit(0.91, 0.96, 1, 0.55), 14
	Else
		DrawString "Space — Pulse sonar", 16, GAME_H - 48, Lit(GLOW_R, GLOW_G, GLOW_B, 0.8), 14
	End If
End Sub
